prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera moves very slowly to the left in a short, smooth arc behind the seated man, keeping him and the laptop in frame, so that the chair and his shoulder slide slightly across the desk and the wall behind them: a gentle parallax move, as on a slider. By the end we see a little more of the back of his head and his back. His face stays turned away from the camera the whole time and is never seen from the side or the front. The windows behind him stay dark and empty the whole time: no reflections, no faces and no figures ever appear in the glass. Keep the image's flat illustrated cut-paper style, textures and colours exactly as they are, including the woven back of the chair; the light does not change. He keeps typing with small movements of his fingers; nothing else in the room moves. Nothing is added: no new objects appear on the desk or in the room. The laptop screen stays blank and bright. Audio: quiet room, soft keystrokes, no music, no voices.
